description: Detailed Kaspa block by 64-character hex hash: timestamp, blue score, DAA score, parents, children, merge set blues/reds, transaction count, difficulty, and selected chain status (isChainBlock). Returns 404 if block is not found. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_kaspa_recent_blocks when you need the most recent Kaspa blocks: hash, block timestamp, blue; crypto_kaspa_chain_color when you need Blue vs red block counts in the merge sets of recent Kaspa. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

hash.description: 64-character lowercase hex hash of the block
